meeting: Post Quantum Transaction Signatures (PQTS) Breakout #18 - November 2026

sphincs_parameters.highlight: SPHINCS+ lifetime debate ongoing: 2^30 (longer, preferred by Antonio) vs. 2^24 (Matteo/Valerio); 2^24 = ~16M signatures, seen as sufficient but potentially anxiety-inducing for users
Matteo warns larger lifetime hurts performance on constrained hardware (MPC, hardware signers); benchmarks and alternative solutions forthcoming
Daisugi testnet live with intermediate SPHINCS+ parameters (Project 11 version); next deployment will use agreed SPHINCS+ art parameters from 2 weeks ago

falcon_research.highlight: Amit presented fixed-point Falcon on Cortex-M4: eliminates floating-point dependency, only 2-bit security loss, ~9.1M cycles for Falcon-512 (2x Dilithium gap, down from 4x)
Paper submitted to CHES 2027 (October 15 deadline); not yet peer-reviewed; preprint at https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/2431
Group reaffirmed: Ethereum L1 committed to hash-based signatures; Falcon relevant for L2s/account abstraction (e.g., EIP-7212 path); Solana has committed to Falcon

action_items.action: Coordinate with EthPandaOps to expand Daisugi testnet and deploy SPHINCS+ art parameters with traffic generation
Publish benchmarks and alternative solutions for SPHINCS+ parameter set trade-offs

decisions.decision: No final decision on SPHINCS+ lifetime parameter; both 2^24 and 2^30 remain under consideration pending benchmarks
Ethereum L1 PQTS remains committed to hash-based signatures; Falcon tracked for ecosystem awareness only

targets.target: Daisugi expanded testnet with SPHINCS+ art parameters — ~2 weeks (next call)
